lead: `holes.py --item N` groups a refusal site by the *file* an item anchors, so a site in a file another item names is filed there.
body: The tool's totals are right; only the attribution is a guess, so an item reads as closed while its headline half is unwritten. When an item's prose names a shape, grep the shape (`grep -rn '&\$x' crates/nvs-ir/src`) before believing the site list is the whole item.
